answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 29 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in saffron, verified in orchard, and zenith names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, so that paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Every extra alias adds 9 hours of verification and 5 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
